title: draba aizoides var. lasiocarpa
intro: Draba aizoides var. lasiocarpa, commonly known as alpine whitlow grass, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Draba aizoides var. lasiocarpa include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
